This '''[[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]''' was present on [[the Rig]] when [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] arrived to demand to know who in the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] posted [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. This hunter was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Windu after attempting to [[Mission to the Rig|attack]] him.
